comments.body:
I seem to recall that the trunk in question was a briefly available UWC item, either in the UWC shop or cove. Only other players would have those equips/trunks for sale right now I'm afraid. A very good hat for most traders with skill boosts like those even if the EX Boost is outclassed by a few other items.

Funnily enough there's a black version with an identical name and EX boost though I don't believe it's been released just yet (and it doesn't show up on the English side of UWO DB yet either).
